scientific_integrity: The proof establishes the infinite-domain asymptotics. Finite quadrature diagnostics are supplemental and not certificates of infinite-dimensional dynamics or independent priority.
scientific_limitations: Only complete uniform translations of the fixed-kernel, Gaussian radial hereditary equation are classified. No claim of stability, global attraction, classification of arbitrary solutions, or general non-Gaussian coefficients. Known translating balance and the ordinary finite-moment orientation theory are credited to the motivating paper.
title: Sharp third-moment transition for Gaussian self-generated memory and its algebraic-tail onset laws
